edges.notes: CDN proxies all cacheable GET requests to api-gateway. Cache miss falls through synchronously.
Every authenticated request calls auth-service /auth/verify before routing. Latency here cascades to all api-gateway p99 latency.
auth-service calls /internal/users/lookup to resolve user identity during token verification.
order-service calls payment-service /payments/charge synchronously during order creation. Failures here block order placement.
order-service fires async POST to notification-service after successful order. Non-blocking — order succeeds even if notification fails.
order-service validates user identity via /internal/users/{id} before order creation.
notification-service fetches user email and push token from /internal/users/{id}/contact.
analytics-pipeline reads directly from order-service's read replica. Not a service-to-service HTTP call.
analytics-pipeline reads from payment-service's read replica for revenue reporting.
